targets.expected_type: ∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) → (∑ j, p j) = 1 → ∀ (w : ι → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) → ∀ i, -(∑ j, p j * w j) ≤ p i * (w i - ∑ j, p j * w j) ∧ p i * (w i - ∑ j, p j * w j) ≤ ∑ j, p j * w j

∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ι → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) → (∑ j, p j) = 1 → ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (p j + p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2 ∧ (p j + p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2

∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ι → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) → (∑ j, p j) = 1 → ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (p j - p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2 ∧ (p j - p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2
∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p v : ι → ℝ) (i : ι), (∑ j, ((p j + p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2) * v j) = ((∑ j, p j * v j) + p i * (v i - ∑ j, p j * v j)) / 2
∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p v : ι → ℝ) (i : ι), (∑ j, ((p j - p i * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - p j)) / 2) * v j) = ((∑ j, p j * v j) - p i * (v i - ∑ j, p j * v j)) / 2
∀ {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (c v : ι → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ c j ∧ c j ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) → 0 ≤ ∑ j, c j * v j ∧ (∑ j, c j * v j) ≤ (∑ j, v j) / 2
